entities.summary: The Speos Artemidos is an archaeological site in Egypt. It is located about 2 km south of the Middle Kingdom tombs at Beni Hasan, and about 28 km south of Al Minya. Today, the site is a small village known as Istabl Antar. Speos Artemidos is a archaeological site from Africa. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
